title: The Scream
narration_slice: and command. When sounded, they produced no ordinary musical note, but a terrifying, bone-shaking scream that seemed to burn the air itself. Millennia later, a single surviving Valyrian dragonhorn pulled from smoking ruins would blister lips and char the lungs of the mortal
filing_note: Batch 053 frames are filed on disk under assets/batch_052/ because that folder was opened for the generation run; the split between batches 052 and 053 is by manifest, not by path.
the_object_rule: Batch 053 inherits the 052 object rule and presses it: the horns are **used, not treasured**. Dull matte black, chipped, stained, hammered gold tarnished except where hands wore it bright. No polish, no gems, no display lighting, no heraldry.
the_scream_rule: The scream is **physical cost, not magic**. It is shown as flush, taut tendons, sweat, a worn and crusted mouthpiece, dry residue, and then a still body on a terrace and one whole horn standing among ruins a civilisation later. **No frame shows an aura, a glow, a shockwave, a sound effect or anything alight.** The sound is inferred from what it did to the mouths that made it.
the_body_rule: No face is ever shown in this batch and no injury is ever shown. Strain is tendons, flush and sweat; damage is dryness, salt deposit and worn metal; the cost is posture - a man on the stones who cannot get up. Negations carried in every prompt: no blood, no wound, no injury, no bruise, no burn.
the_glyph_rule: Inherited from 052: incised marks are dense, clustered, worn and unreadable at magnification. 0522 was checked at 3x, 0524 at 4x, 0525 at 9x, 0529 at 6x. All clean - no letterforms, no runes, no numerals.

scenes.visual_beat: Towering vertical scale composition — Red-gold-banded Valyrian dragonbinder horns & fiery glyphs
scenes.qc_note: LAM 24mm from directly below the bell: a dragonbinder horn fills a tower of frame, the open mouth overhead a dark irregular ellipse with the rim **chipped in one place and worn smooth on the inner lip**. A thin drift of smoke is drawn out of the mouth and away - **not glowing, not alight, nothing magical**, just grey vapour moving in still air. One hammered gold band close to the camera, its tooling faceted and tarnished. The face of the blower is out of frame below; only the upraised arms and the shoulders of a coarse mantle enter at the bottom edge. Two light sources: cold daylight from a high opening and a dull warm bounce off the stones. **Nothing in this frame says the horn is magic - it says the horn is being blown hard.**

scenes.visual_beat: Macro environmental / material texture insert — Red-gold-banded Valyrian dragonbinder horns & fiery glyphs
scenes.qc_note: 85mm macro into the throat of the horn: **densely scored rows crossing one another in one cluster**, chisel cuts with rough walls, grit packed into the troughs, grain ridges between them, one hairline crack running through the field. Checked at 3x - the cuts stay parallel tool travel and fracture, **no mark resolves into a letter, rune or numeral anywhere in the frame**, which is the glyph rule holding under maximum magnification. Shallow depth of field puts the scoring sharp and lets both edges of the frame fall soft. Warm raking light along the cuts with cold fill in the shadow; every surface matte and dry.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up detail / expression beat — Red-gold-banded Valyrian dragonbinder horns & fiery glyphs
scenes.qc_note: 85mm close on the **throat and jaw of a man mid-effort**, cropped at the mouth and at the collarbone so that **no face is present at all** - no eyes, no nose above the upper lip, no identity. What the frame is about is strain as anatomy: **tendons standing out of the neck in long cords, the sternocleidomastoid cutting a hard diagonal, the jaw clamped, skin flushed deep red under cold light with a sheen of sweat at the throat**, the collar of a coarse dark mantle open and damp at its edge. Behind him the horn's blunt silhouette is out of focus against warm stone and one small lantern flare. **No blood, no wound, no injury, no bruise - the body is working, not damaged.**

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up tactile / light study — Red-gold-banded Valyrian dragonbinder horns & fiery glyphs
scenes.qc_note: 100mm extreme close on **the mouthpiece of the horn where it has been set down**: a heavy worn rim of horn and gold, the gold gone nearly black at the contact patch and **crusted with a ring of dry residue** - the pale salt-and-ash deposit of mouths and breath over years, cracked into plates, some flaked away to bright metal beneath. The rim itself is **abraded flat on one side and pitted**, no engraving, no inscription, checked at 4x. It rests on coarse fire-blackened stone with ash and grit around it. Low warm light from the right, deep black upper-left, one thin specular on the brightest remaining gold. **The object's history written in deposit rather than decoration.**

scenes.visual_beat: Transitional wide horizon / bridge framing — Red-gold-banded Valyrian dragonbinder horns & fiery glyphs
scenes.qc_note: 40mm wide across a high stone terrace above a drowned plain. At frame left, **a dragonbinder horn stands socketed upright in a ring of flat stones**, its surface scored and its gold dull. At frame right, well away from it, **a single robed figure lies face down and completely still on the flagstones**, one arm out, boots trailing - **no wound, no blood, no visible cause; a posture, not an injury, and the face turned away into the ground.** Beyond the terrace edge the world drops away into flat white haze, a cliff face and a pale horizon. The sky is **flat overcast grey from edge to edge - no stars, no moon, no glow, no fire anywhere.** Letterboxed on arrival; reframed to 1376x768. Two figures' worth of distance between the horn and the body is the whole content of the shot.
scenes.note_reframe: Letterboxed on arrival (content rows 39-727); cropped 1376x689+0+39 and resampled to 1376x768. md5 is the delivered file.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — Mortal cost of sounding horns & High Valyrian binding spells
scenes.qc_note: 28mm low angle, four hundred years later: **a single dragonhorn still standing upright on a broken plinth among the ruins of a dead city**, monumental against the sky. Ruins read as **poured fused stone - curved sheets, warped slabs, fracture faces and drips - rather than coursed blocks**, black and grey, half-collapsed into itself, with thin smoke rising from the ground in the middle distance and no fire visible. The horn is dull black with tarnished bands, its tip intact, **chipped and weathered but whole - the only intact thing in the frame**, and no person anywhere. Flat overcast, low contrast, ash-grey palette. **The civilisation is gone and the instrument is not.**

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — Mortal cost of sounding horns & High Valyrian binding spells
scenes.qc_note: 40mm over the shoulder of a hooded figure standing with his back to camera, **face entirely lost inside the hood**, looking down at a dragonhorn **fallen and half-buried in rubble**, its body passing under a slab, its **open bell crushed and split at the rim**, gold band corroded to a dull rust-red at the fracture. Grey dust and grit settled over everything, stone shards and broken slabs around it. Behind, the dead city's fused walls stand and smoke drifts. Cold flat daylight, two sources only. **The shot is the discovery: a thing built to be sounded, found ruined and silent.** The figure's hood is the only dark shape in the frame and it never turns.

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide atmospheric composition — Mortal cost of sounding horns & High Valyrian binding spells
scenes.qc_note: 28mm deep-focus wide of the dead city from ground level, **every surface poured fused stone: curved sheets standing as walls, warped fins and slabs slumped into the ground, fracture faces and frozen drips, no courses and no joints.** A small robed figure seen from behind at three-quarter angle, hood up, face hidden, **braced with both arms hauling a long horn out from under a fallen slab** - the horn dull black with one tarnished gold band and dust in its grooves. Foreground rubble sharp with the near slab edge out of focus. Thin smoke far off, flat overcast sky in the upper third, **no fire, no burning city, no stars.** Pass 1 failed on coursed ashlar and was re-rendered; this pass reads as fracture, not masonry, verified at 3x.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — Mortal cost of sounding horns & High Valyrian binding spells
scenes.qc_note: 24mm very close, the mouthpiece pressed to a closed mouth: **flushed skin across the lower face, the mouth clamped down on the gold, lips dry and cracked with the broken skin of a blister in the lower lip**, cords standing in the neck, a coarse hood edge out of focus at frame left. Only jaw, mouth, chin and a suggestion of cheek are in frame - **the eyes and forehead are cropped out, so there is no portrait and no gaze.** The horn's body curves away right with an incised band of crossed scoring, unreadable at 6x, no letterforms. **No blood, no burn, no wound** - the damage is dryness and heat, which is what the narration claims and no more. Cold key from the left, dim warm bounce below.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — Mortal cost of sounding horns & High Valyrian binding spells
scenes.qc_note: 50mm medium close-up: a robed figure **slumped back against a wall of poured dark stone, chest heaving, head tipped back and turned aside so the face is entirely swallowed by the hood's shadow** - no features, no eyes, no identity. Collar open, throat and collarbone **flushed and sweat-sheened**, one hand open and slack on the flagstones, the other fallen across the knee. The horn lies where it was set down beside him on the stones, dull black, chipped, its gold grey. Flat overcast light from a high opening, one low lantern at frame left for warmth, the vault above lost to pure black. **Materials and posture carry the mortality, never injury: no blood, no wound, no burn marks.** The sequence ends on a man who cannot get up and an instrument that does not care.
